announcements.t: Technocraft Ventures Limited has submitted the Exchange the voting results along with the consolidated Scrutinizer's report in respect of the Twenty-eighth Annual General Meeting of the Company held on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

Technocraft Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding re-appointment of M/s. Rishi Kapoor & Company, Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration No: 006615C), as Statutory Auditors of the Company
Technocraft Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding summary of proceedings of the 28th Annual General Meeting ("AGM") of the Company held today, i.e., Wednesday, September 30, 2026.
